headline: Sensex surges over 1,100 points as FII inflows, Q2 results, and lower oil prices boost sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows driven by optimism around foreign capital flows.
Strong Q2 earnings results boosting investor confidence across key corporate sectors.
Declining international crude oil prices providing support to equity valuations.
Broad-based buying interest led by financial and automobile sector stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex surged up to 1,302 points while Nifty crossed the 25,350 level to hit multi-month highs.
Hindustan Copper reported a 47% rise in Q2 net profit, while Tata Power posted a 49% profit jump.
Cupid reported Q2 highlights with revenue more than doubling.
Noel Tata retired as chairman of Tata Investment, with Bahram Vakil taking over.
summary: Indian benchmark indices recorded sharp gains, with Sensex surging over 1,100 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,350. The rally was fueled by strong FII inflows, declining crude oil prices, and robust Q2 corporate earnings. Financials, autos, and energy stocks led the broad-based market surge.
